sonnet.problem: The card asks the baker to pick the exact wording of the closing proclamation (upright and Rock, versus gentle and Shepherd, or merciful and Light). Nothing on the earlier cards lets a baker reason to 'upright' or 'Rock'. 'Rock' has not appeared anywhere before, so the pick is a guess at the line's words.
sonnet.rule: Never ask the baker to guess the next words of a line.

sonnet.problem: This story card re-tells verse 15, the line that choice card 17 just asked about and answered (the LORD is upright, He is my Rock). It adds no new part of the passage, so it works as a recap and reuses an answer already shown.
